item.title: About Us
item.author: MD Gaziur Rahman Noor
item.description:
About Us🔗

ReSINC stands for Research in Security, Intelligence & Cyberthreat.

We are an independent research group dedicated to exploring the depths of cybersecurity. Founded in 2024, our group has steadily grown into a hub for cutting-edge security research, focusing on threat intelligence, binary exploitation, and reverse engineering.

Whether you're a seasoned professional or a student looking to get into the field, we believe in sharing knowledge and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in infosec.

Our Achievements🔗

We are proud of the work we have accomplished so far in the field of security and intelligence. Here are some of our major milestones:

  • 1st Place at CyberSec Hackathon 2025: Developed a novel malware detection algorithm.
  • Published Research: Our paper on "Context Switching Vulnerabilities" was accepted at DEF CON.
  • Community Award: Recognized for outstanding contributions to open-source security tools.

Stay tuned for more updates!

item.title: Our Goal
item.author: MD Gaziur Rahman Noor
item.description:
Our Goal🔗

At ReSINC, our primary goal is to advance the state of cybersecurity through rigorous research, open collaboration, and intelligence sharing.

We aim to:

  1. Identify emerging cyber threats before they become mainstream.
  2. Educate the community on best practices for secure software development.
  3. Develop open-source tools to assist in threat hunting and intelligence gathering.

Together, we can build a more secure digital ecosystem.

item.title: Introducing ReSINC
item.author: MD Gaziur Rahman Noor
item.description:
We are extremely excited to officially announce the launch of ReSINC — Research in Security, Intelligence & Cyberthreat.

Our group was formed with a simple mission: to explore the intricate depths of cybersecurity, conduct cutting-edge research, and share our intelligence with the community. As cyber threats evolve at an unprecedented pace, proactive research and open collaboration become our strongest defenses.

What to Expect?🔗

On this blog, we will be regularly publishing:

  • Threat Intelligence Reports: In-depth analysis of emerging malware, APT groups, and active campaigns.
  • Vulnerability Research: Detailed write-ups on zero-days, binary exploitation, and reverse engineering.
  • CTF Write-ups: Walkthroughs and solutions for challenging Capture The Flag competitions.
  • Tool Releases: Open-source utilities we develop for threat hunting and forensic analysis.

We invite researchers, students, and professionals to join us on this journey. Stay tuned for our upcoming research publications and let's build a more secure future together!
